propositions: The wire history processor never validates the first request against context window because proc() only descends into ModelResponse messages and the sole raise site (_wire_keeps_response) is unreachable when history contains only [ModelRequest].
An oversized first request (3.6M chars against 1M token window) passes unchecked and surfaces as LLMUnavailableError instead of being caught before the provider call.
A shared request-fit check at chars/token=4 calibration must be added to proc() to catch first and subsequent requests equally, raising ContextWindowExceededError when estimate + reserve > window.
Existing per-op bounds (enrich's window*2-char limit) remain admissible under chars/4 estimation, scoring at ~window/2 tokens and passing the seam.
The fix preserves all carried-response include/omit/raise logic and existing error-handling paths (13 broad LLMError handlers) since ContextWindowExceededError is an LLMRunnerError subclass.
